evidence.quote: we route every reaction through one bundle per run per person
a person should get one thing to read, not four

observations.why: Establishes a normative routing rule and design principle specifying intended future/ongoing behavior across general runs and persons.

evidence.quote:
the bundle closes when
the run closes, and a skill that misses the close waits for the next run

observations.why: Formulates settled, systemic mechanics for how bundle closure and run batching operate.

evidence.quote:
The alternative considered and rejected was per-skill
delivery with client-side collapsing

observations.why: Reflects on a past, completed evaluation and rejection of an architectural pattern.
